name: Shivalik Foothills Institute of Medical Sciences
description: A specialty-focused institute at the foot of the Shivalik hills with a cochlear implant and hearing centre, retina and cornea services, joint replacement, an epilepsy clinic and fertility care; Dari, Pashto, Uzbek and Russian interpreters on call.
